title: Match the Emoji
one_line: A cozy emoji memory-matching game with 3 difficulty levels, live scoring, a timer, and saved best scores.
how_to_play: Click two cards to flip them face up. Matching emoji stay revealed; mismatches flip back. Find every pair to win.
description: Match the Emoji is a beginner-friendly memory-matching game built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no libraries required. Choose Easy (6 pairs), Medium (8 pairs), or Hard (12 pairs), then flip cards two at a time to find every matching pair. Quick, low-guesswork matches earn more points; a live HUD tracks score, pairs found, moves, and elapsed time. The end screen shows a final score, move count, time, and a rank from Keep Practicing up to Legendary Matcher, with a best score saved per difficulty. Works with mouse, touch, or keyboard on desktop and mobile browsers.
